title: NEW: git-lock-check's CA-203 replacement liveness probe uses a relative .git as an unanchored pgrep ERE and self-matches, so the removal branch is unreachable and the scoping comment states the opposite

CA-196 partially fixed: the nearest-rank ceiling is correct but at N=3/5/10 the emitted p95_ms is definitionally the maximum, and the published T67/CLAUDE.md figures are still the pre-fix biased-low numbers
NEW: _git_lock_age_bucket's lowest bucket (-mmin +1) disagrees with the removal gate (-mmin +0), so a 60-119s lock prints 'less than 1 minute' and is then removed with that message

NEW/aggravated: cleanup() is trapped on INT/TERM but only its exit-4 branch terminates, so an interrupt before STARTED resumes the script against a deleted scratch tree and reports exit 2 with a misleading cause
CA-182 re-verified FIXED: cmd_approve_gate's convergence precheck now runs unconditionally and only the exit-3 no-JSONL arm degrades below schema_version 2
CA-019 re-verified FIXED: mermaid_scan_awk loads the shared edm-mermaid-rules.awk via -f and the score-artifacts ignore-marker divergence is now documented as a deliberate carve-out
CA-184 re-verified FIXED: with_state_lock's mkdir branch captures the forked body's status on the same statement, so trap restoration and lock release always run
CA-185 re-verified FIXED: attribution_mode is a two-value enum again and torn lines are counted in a new unparseable_lines field with an informational TORN_TOKEN_LINES anomaly
CA-186 re-verified FIXED: the commit hook strips trailing slashes, refuses an absolute srd_root loudly, and passes the root through ENVIRON rather than awk -v
CA-187 re-verified FIXED: the EDM-HELP block now states the real exit-1-vs-exit-2 hook contract and the derived srd_root behaviour, and CLAUDE.md agrees
CA-017 re-verified FIXED: all seven violation classes reaching report_violation are enumerated in --help and CLAUDE.md no longer hardcodes a count
CA-197 re-verified FIXED: --mermaid-ratio prints UNMEASURABLE and exits 3 when either p95 is zero instead of emitting a millisecond count labelled as a multiplier
CA-198 re-verified FIXED: HANDOFF.md is written through the new newline-terminating _print_line renderer while _print_literal stays unchanged for the pattern splice
CA-199 re-verified FIXED: cmd_update_patterns resolves the patterns directory from the BASH_SOURCE-derived SCRIPT_DIR global instead of re-deriving it from $0
--provision-only now runs prune_old_runs via the EXIT trap, but the default gitignored runs/ root and the run-ID ownership filter keep it harmless
The per-dimension delta table joins baseline to candidate positionally, but build_dims_json always emits all five DIM_NAMES entries in fixed order so the join is safe by construction
srd_root normalization strips only one leading ./ so a pathological ././SRD would still disable enforcement; all three defects CA-186 named are fixed
The CA-209 flock timeout marker introduces a new ${lockfile}.timeout.$$ path shape; the control flow is correct and the gitignore-coverage question belongs to L5's CA-212 class
_p95's ceiling arithmetic is itself correct for every N; only the sample count and the key name remain, folded into the CA-196 finding rather than filed separately
Accepts -h and --help but not the bare help token eleven siblings accept -- an L7 family-consistency question, not a logic defect
